title: #199 Communication Change
prompt: The means of communicating in society today has changed greatly over the last ten years. Is it a positive or negative change?

Is it a positive or negative change?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Modern communication makes it easy to talk to people far away, allowing people to keep in touch with friends and family across many countries.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Modern communication makes it easy to talk to people far away, allowing people to keep in touch with friends and family across many countries.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, this change has negative aspects, such as people spending too much time looking at screens and potentially losing real-life talking skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, this change has negative aspects, such as people spending too much time looking at screens and potentially losing real-life talking skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses how new communication methods help people connect and keep families close.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph discusses how new communication methods help people connect and keep families close.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the negative aspect of communication changes, specifically the loss of face-to-face talking skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph discusses the negative aspect of communication changes, specifically the loss of face-to-face talking skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that the shift to digital communication is positive, focusing on the advantage of global connection and the disadvantage of privacy risks.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that the shift to digital communication is positive, focusing on the advantage of global connection and the disadvantage of privacy risks.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The structure adheres to the required PEEL format in both body paragraphs, using specific linking phrases and maintaining a B2 vocabulary level.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses the positive aspect of global reach and ease of connection through digital methods.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
